pipeline.description: Choose the models and options used to process each page.

enhancement.mangajpegDescription: Remove JPEG artifacts with the model matched to the page's compression. Off: only a light edge-preserving filter.
enhancement.toneDescription: Make near-black ink black and near-white paper white on monochrome pages. Mid-tones and tinted pages stay as they are.

ocr.instructionsDescription: Guidance for exact transcription, reading order, furigana, or sound effects.
ocr.hybridDescription: Complete local OCR for every page in the chapter, then check the drafts with the selected API model. Results are applied automatically.
ocr.crossCheck: Cross-check with a second local model
ocr.crossCheckDescription: Read every crop with a second local model too and send only crops where the two disagree to the API. Turn off to send every crop: about three times the cost, slightly more accurate on handwriting.

markup.instructionsDescription: Appended to the markup request, for example hints about the characters.

inpainting.removeDescription: Local model for the Remove brush. Independent of page cleanup and rectangular restoration.
inpainting.restorationDescription: API model for the Restore tool with a rectangular selection. Independent of page cleanup and the Remove brush.
inpainting.previewBeforeSendDescription: Show the outgoing image and edit the prompt before API page cleanup or Restore selection. Local Remove is unaffected.

detection.description: Find text, speech bubbles, and panels.

ocr.description: Read the source text inside detected regions.

markup.title: Scene markup

imageEditPreview.title: Preview image-edit request

imageEditPreview.restorationLayers: Selected area of the original + visible Cleanup and Paint layers, in layer order. One PNG; text layers, masks and handles are excluded.
